decisions.summary: Files: canonical list, sync-state JSON and hand-state JSON under research/; the GM's copy written by sync only; a session may hand-edit an entry's text
decisions.why: FR-001 beside the record, FR-007 sync record, FR-011 hand states in one file, US2 scenario 4 session edits

decisions.summary: Entry format and the three mark lines, with a dated recorded line
One-time import: header, high-risk section first, the GM's file unchanged; 1-6, 8, 12-16 downloaded and 7, 9, 10, 11 not found from the 2026-09-13 table
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-004; checked against the GM's status table (7, 9, 10, 11 CLOSED - unavailable; 16 'You already saved a PDF')

decisions.summary: Ingest as a three-way comparison against synced.commit; marks recorded while text edits wait for KEEP=/DROP=; unknown ids named and pending; refused before the first sync
Ingest refuses found-elsewhere without downloaded or partial, and not-found with 'either' (downloaded or partial) - paywalled left out
decisions.why: FR-005 and US2 scenario 2 refuse not-found with downloaded, partial OR paywalled (widened in spec round 1). The plan's refusal lets not-found plus paywalled through, a combination FR-011 rule 1 gives no state for. Nothing makes the spec's rule impossible. Fix: 'not-found with downloaded, partial or paywalled'.

decisions.summary: Sync refuses unless the copy's sha matches imported/synced/ingested or the copy is absent; refuses on an uncommitted canonical list; records sha, date, commit
decisions.why: FR-007, US3; the uncommitted-list refusal binds only the session and keeps the base a commit

decisions.summary: make download-add from a draft; checks link, fallback, an existing record pointer, blocked-by; next number under the host-wide lock over mirror, clones and a ledger; appended at the end
HIGH_RISK=1 takes the next H<n> and inserts it at the end of the high-risk section, which D11's push check allows
decisions.why: FR-008 appends at the end and FR-010 refuses an entry inserted anywhere but the end; the request moves the 'goes at the END' rule to the canonical list, enforced by tooling. Neither the request nor 312's spec grows the high-risk list (312 FR-021: the 22 sources; 312's request makes the high-risk list a query). The carve-out serves no case asked for, and it defeats the END rule's purpose: the GM, working down the copy, would miss an entry inserted in a section already done. Fix: drop HIGH_RISK=1 and D11's H-insertion allowance.

decisions.summary: Inbox MATCH takes an entry id; resolves to its keys or []; saved-as files matched without asking; unmatched files wait
An entry's keys: backticked registry keys, manifest keys of linked URLs, optional '- Key:' line
decisions.why: definition the spec leaves open; serves FR-011 and the several-keys edge case

decisions.summary: Rule 1 mark mapping and several-entries rule; manifest outcome mapping (404/410 gone, timeout/5xx down, else bot-refused) and the openness order; READ gives open; hand state wins over 2-4 on same date or later, never over a mark
decisions.why: FR-011 rules 1, 2, 4 and the hand-state rule as accepted; the outcome mapping and order define what the spec says is stated in one file

decisions.summary: New rule 3: a manifest-derived bot-refused, down or gone becomes never-read when the registry entry has no READ comment
decisions.why: FR-011 says the most open manifest row decides, then READ, then never-read; US5 scenario 2 requires a key whose only row is a 403 partial to be bot-refused, with no READ condition. The plan's justification ('three states kept apart') is the session's own summary in 312's request, not the GM's words. Measured 2026-10-02 (registry <h3> ids vs any READ comment vs archive/*/*.json outcomes): 8 works-cited keys have no READ comment and only partial/unreachable rows, so the rule would tag cited sources 'never read (referenced only)'. Fix: drop rule 3; amend the spec through review if the distinction is wanted.

decisions.summary: A keyless list entry (download:<id>) takes rule 1, else never-read
decisions.why: FR-011 gives every keyless entry a state under the same rules, hand-recorded states included, and seeds list entries whose Blocked by says paywalled as hand states. Most of those are keyless (248 of 306 entries are), so 'else never-read' throws away the seeds D9a records. Fix: rule 1, then a hand state, then never-read.

decisions.summary: Seeds: paywall prose in registry and list entries recorded by SET one by one, dated 2026-10-02, quoting the line; open, other-work and GM-full mentions passed over; the list goes in research.md
decisions.why: FR-011 seeding; skipping GM-full mentions stops a dated seed outranking the GM's copy

decisions.summary: make access-tags with KEY=, JSON=1, SET=
Guard download-copy-hooks.sh refusing Edit/Write/shell writes to the GM's copy with the add/sync commands; escape DOWNLOAD_COPY_OK, logged
decisions.why: FR-009, SC-004; a logged escape with a reason is the project's standing guard form

decisions.summary: Push check against origin/main: lost id, reorder, new id not at end or not above main's highest, reused id, malformed marks; selftest first; passes while absent on main
decisions.why: FR-010 (its H-section allowance is ruled under D6-high-risk)

decisions.summary: Rule rewritten in CLAUDE.md, research/CLAUDE.md, the doctrine, record rules, page-session rules; ingest/sync documented; guard-table row
Tooling only, DIRECT route, no perf bookends or map reviews; reuse of Lock, inbox and guard-log helpers
decisions.why: nothing on a map changes (spec Decisions)
